author: real_leovo
body:
Age: 14
Timezone: 0:00 pm BST LONDON
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: yes i do have TeamSpeak
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: yes i do my skype is: kai123954
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: yes OBS is what i use.

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? yes i do but like i said i own one for a rp team but the others i lost cause my pc got factory reset then i got mod on one server but then all my servers wiped so im still trying to find it i was admin or mod or youtube or CO_owner/Head_Admin. so i do have a lot.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? im ok at pex and good and commands and i am active i love the gamemodes and i dont really have a weakness for it i stay calm and yes.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? it be hard to top of the staff team as there already doing a good job but i want to help out and i can a lot after school and when im free.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? a leader need to understand whats right or wrong and needs to follow there own rules, or any other rules and they well be nice to the team or other people. i say i can be a good leader

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? i would do what they ask if i was allowed like and explain to what they should be doing from what there not doing it correct, i didn't really get this question sorry.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? you need to be patient and chill and u have to be understandable for what they say and you need let people speak. i do have it them skills


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? maybe monday-friday as long as i can maybe 1-6hours per day and Saturday and Sunday as long as i want and can maybe 2.5- 7 hours 


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? well first i thought junior mod trials cant ban but if they can i would record him ip ban him then if he evades ip ban him which is possible then i would blacklist him (ive been through it before when i was admin on a server.)


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? well first i would speak to the people without the staff member and ask whats he been doing, if the staff member was doing it for purpose or no reason then i would speak to him and say leave them alone but if like he had to speak cause he thought one was hacking and checking then i would leave him but be in there to see if hes doing the correct thing.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? well i would go to recycling bin and if it is not there i would have to let him go but record and watch him for a bit.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? i would say delete it before people see it who shouldn't but if he does not defan mute him until a higher rank deals with him 


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? ask another staff member who knows what going on and see if he sais the same thing if he does then i would speak to a higher rank but if it helps the server i still will speak to a higher rank and see what he sais


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? a lot it would make me so happy as i love the server so much its deferentially one of the best server ive been on.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? again a lot i really enjoy playing it and ive used a lot of time on the server and i would use a lot more, the staff are sooo nice and helpful i would love to know more of them and be one of them


Do you speak any other languages than English? no but ive learnt a tiny bit of french which i wont be able to understand or speak yet.


Do you have anything else to add to your application? not really but i really do like your staff team and the server its self its sooooo goood and i really hope i get accepted also i will do vids for youtube on it also live streams. the Mini games are the best ive seen around and i cant stop playing them, there so addicting.
